# jamfplatform_pro_licensed_software (Data Source)

Look up a Jamf Pro licensed software record by ID or by exact name. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be supplied. Surfaces a flat read-only projection of the general header; manage the record as a resource for the nested software definitions and licences.

**Required Jamf privileges**

The Jamf Platform API integration used by the provider must be granted the following privileges:

| Required privilege |
|---|
| `licensed-software:read` |

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a licensed software record by exact name (or set id instead).
data "jamfplatform_pro_licensed_software" "by_name" {
  name = "Acme Editor"
}

# Look up by ID.
data "jamfplatform_pro_licensed_software" "by_id" {
  id = "65"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Record ID. Mutually exclusive with `name`.
- `name` (String) Display name (exact match). Mutually exclusive with `id`.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `exclude_titles_purchased_from_app_store` (Boolean) Whether Mac App Store copies are excluded from the licence count.
- `notes` (String) Notes about the record.
- `platform` (String) Platform the software is for.
- `publisher` (String) Name of the licensed software publisher.
- `remove_titles_from_inventory_reports` (Boolean) Whether matched titles are excluded from inventory reports.
- `send_email_on_violation` (Boolean) Whether an email notification is sent when the licence count is exceeded.
- `site_id` (String) Site ID. `-1` means no site.
- `site_name` (String) Site display name.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
